about_the_game:
“Wanderer’s Deck” is a dark fantasy strategy game that blends roguelike progression with card-based combat. Players take the role of a mysterious wanderer exploring dungeons, stepping through unknown doors, and facing unexpected encounters.

Key Features:

Card-Based Battles → Use attack, defense, and special ability cards to build strategies and defeat enemies.

Roguelike Progression → Every run is unique; choices change your fate, and no two journeys are the same.

Deck Building & Upgrades → Collect new cards, enhance your deck, and create powerful combinations.

Boss Encounters → Face mighty bosses lurking in the depths of dungeons; only sharp strategy ensures survival.

Choices & Uncertainty → You never know what lies beyond the doors. Will you take the risk or choose the safer path?

With its atmosphere of dark dungeons, ancient runes, and mysterious creatures, every choice you make rewrites your destiny. Your ultimate goal: survive and claim victory.

  • DirectX: Version 11
